content: {"praised":["Acting by Joanne Whalley-Kilmer and Timothy Dalton is excellent.","Film is lavish, epic, and engaging.","Fresh portrayal of Scarlett adds passion and scope.","Rhett character portrayed better than previous versions.","Story ties up loose ends from original."],"criticized":["Fails to capture essence of original story.","Deviations from book ruin narrative.","Poor adaptation of sequel material.","Tone and pacing feel off.","Characters lack depth compared to original."]}
